# Zentrix Aero 14

The Zentrix Aero 14 is a thin and light business notebook designed for professionals who move between the office, client sites and home. It pairs a sharp fourteen-inch display with a quiet cooling system and a keyboard tuned for long writing sessions.

## Specifications

The Aero 14 uses the latest efficient mobile processor, with integrated graphics that handle video calls, presentations and light photo editing. Storage is a fast solid state drive, and the chassis is machined from recycled aluminium.

FACT: Zentrix Aero 14 has 16 GB of RAM in the standard business configuration.
FACT: Zentrix Aero 14 weighs 1 point 3 kg.
FACT: Zentrix Aero 14 costs 1290 dollars per unit for business buyers.

## Display and audio

The fourteen-inch panel offers a matte finish to reduce glare in bright offices. A full HD webcam with a privacy shutter sits above the screen, and dual microphones use noise suppression so colleagues hear you clearly even in shared spaces.

## Ports and connectivity

The Aero 14 includes two USB-C ports with charging support, one USB-A port, a full-size HDMI output and a headphone jack. Wireless connectivity covers the latest Wi-Fi standard and Bluetooth. An optional docking station lets employees connect two external monitors with a single cable.

## Manageability

IT teams can enrol the Aero 14 in common device management platforms out of the box. Firmware updates are delivered through the operating system update channel, and a hardware security chip supports full-disk encryption. A three year on-site warranty is included with business orders of ten units or more.

Battery life is rated at up to eleven hours of mixed office use, and the bundled charger can restore half capacity in about forty minutes.
